stem: A healthcare operations study measures the wait time (minutes) for a sample of 40 emergency room visitors. The sample mean is 128.2 min with a sample standard deviation of 24.9 min. Assuming the data are approximately normally distributed, estimate the true population mean and provide a 95% confidence interval.

ground_truth.answer: Population mean ≈ 128.2 min. 95% CI = [120.2, 136.2]. Point estimate: 128.2 min.

common_failure_modes: Using z-critical value instead of t-critical for small samples
Not reporting the confidence interval alongside the point estimate
